run_test_rmsprop_tf_optimizer: run the unit test for the RMSPropTF optimizer with TensorFlow-style configuration
test_rmsprop_tf_config: test the RMSPropTF optimizer configuration with lr, momentum, weight_decay, alpha, eps, and centered parameters
run_test_optimizer_instance: run the test suite that validates the RMSPropTF optimizer instance creation
test_rmsprop_tf_with_momentum: test the RMSPropTF optimizer with momentum set to 0.9 and alpha set to 0.9
run_test_rmsprop_tf_weight_decay: run the test for RMSPropTF optimizer with weight decay of 0.0001 over 90 epochs
